name: Barrage of Styles [Combat, Selfless, Teamwork]
body:
You blend the diverse martial traditions of you and your allies’ backgrounds into a unique combination.

Prerequisite(s): Base attack bonus +1.

Benefit(s): You grant a cumulative +1 morale bonus (maximum +4) on combat maneuver checks to each ally who is threatening the same foe and does not share an ethnicity or ancestry with you or any other ally threatening that foe.
